_comment: DRAFT (dialogue-drafts lane 2026-07-06, NOT wired). Rotating talk_pool line sets for every STAGED character with a voice contract (character-profiles-staging.md). Shape matches skeleton_scene.json entity data: talk_pool = array of strings (rotation = chatted_with_<id> % size, zero rng); talk_pool_post = {requires_accomplishment, lines} per Lyonette C4 growth precedent. Entity ids are SUGGESTIONS — the map lane owns real ids. Canon cites + per-character notes: talk_pools.md.

talk_pool: The garden grows what the field won't. Root talk. You'd find it dull. The roots don't.
Guild runners get lost twice finding this place. You got lost once. Improvement.
Antler, willowbark, patience. Two of those I can stock.
Bridge holding good today. Planks counted. All there.
Toll is not robbing. Robbing has no bridge. Big difference.
River loud today. Fish rude. No toll for fish. Yet.

lines: Wagon at dawn. Ox angry, man angrier, cabbages. Paid no toll — wagon too fast. Remembered forever.
Big deer on north field. Antlers ORANGE. Not on fire. Checked twice.
Boulder by east rocks MOVED. Boulders not move. This one moves. Watching it. Not blinking much.
More goblins on gate road. Not my goblins. My goblins is me.

talk_pool: Tea first. Then troubles. The kettle has heard worse than yours.
Prices are only cruel to people who wanted the thing for free.
The bent trees? They asked to grow that way. Everything here pays or is paid.
Barley's up where the rot was. I check it mornings. Twice. It's habit now, and I'm keeping it.
A village runs on weather, tempers, and the ledger. I can only argue with two of those.
If you need feeding, the longhouse feeds. That's not hospitality, that's policy. ...It's a bit hospitality.

talk_pool: Tea first. Then troubles. The kettle has heard worse than yours.
Prices are only cruel to people who wanted the thing for free.

lines: Split wood all morning at the hollow. My words, my blisters. Good trade.
Mother asked who the stranger was. I said: the one who made me pay my own bills. She laughed. I'd forgotten her laugh wasn't borrowed too.
The barley doesn't hold grudges. People take longer. I'm on the mend with both.

talk_pool: Fine evening, sir. Somewhere in this city a man's having a far worse one. We do try to be selective about which man.
The hat stays on, sir. You'd know about it if it didn't — begging your pardon for the hypothetical.
Mind the alleys past the fish racks, sir. Or don't. You're getting known there, which is the better umbrella.
Everything on this street has two prices — the asked and the agreed. The city runs on the gap.
Flattery? No, no. Appraisal. You're worth more than you were last week. Do keep it up.
I never raise my voice. Raised voices are for men whose money can't speak for them.
Fresh pot, fresh rumors. One's about a fish the size of a rowboat, and in fairness — that one may just be a fish.
I'd call gossip a vice, but it's fed me eleven years. So I call it an economy.
Sit at anyone's elbow long enough and you become furniture. Talking furniture. Listening furniture.
Three observations. One: you walk more than you ride — good. Two: your left boot wears faster — correct it. Three: there was no three. Rewarding attention is a training principle.
Magic is muscle. Muscle is repetition. The rest is excuses wearing robes.
I respect effort in every species. I have yet to meet an excuse I respect.
State your business and your sponsor. If you have neither, the forms for acquiring both are on the wall behind you.
The stamp is not a formality. The stamp is the difference between a guest and an incident.
Pallass welcomes you. Warmly. In writing.
Don't step where the floor's clean. Clean means something eats the dust.
Half-Elf patience is real. Ksmvr is a real test of it. We're both still here, so it holds.
The circlet's not decorative. The gloves are. Don't ask about the gloves.
Byres silver. It's for the armor, not vanity. ...Mostly the armor.
Don't shake my hand too hard. Old story. The short version is also long.
I hit things, and I stand in front of other things. Every party needs somebody simple.
I am waving. This is the correct number of arms for waving. I have confirmed this with Captain Ceria.
I am told I should 'break the ice.' There is no ice present. I remain prepared regardless.
Please rate my greeting. Comrade Yvlon says I should not ask that. I am asking quietly.
